profile.name: Chandra Syahputra
profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer & Tech Builder
about: I design and build software systems at the intersection of agriculture, supply chain traceability, and mobile tech.
My work focuses on architecting offline-first mobile solutions, secure sync protocols, and developer-friendly tooling.

research.narrative: I am interested in building resilient data sync mechanisms and secure audit logs that allow agricultural transactions to be recorded reliably, even in remote or low-connectivity environments.

focus.name: AgriTech Platforms
focus.description: Designing transaction and quota management systems for sustainable supply chains.

focus.name: Offline-First Mobile
focus.description: Developing robust data synchronization architectures for Android and mobile devices.

focus.name: Data Security
focus.description: Implementing secure local database encryption (AES-256) and API key protections.

projects.name: GeoHarvest App
projects.summary: Mobile and web client platforms for managing supply chain logistics, quota tracking, and transactions.

footer: Building reliable tools that bridge real-world supply chains with modern software.
